data.name: Kadaniel
data.long_meaning: Kadaniel is derived from the Hebrew words 'Kad' (east) and 'El' (God). It means 'God is my righteousness'. This name is mentioned in the Bible as a name of an angel or a heavenly being. It symbolizes the idea of being protected and sustained by God.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that evokes a sense of divine protection and righteousness.
